title: Inspect binary extracted files
changes: Allow any local extracted file to be inspected as paginated hexadecimal bytes with offsets and printable ASCII, while preserving text and structured JSON views.
Support exact hexadecimal byte search with bounded reads and highlighted matching rows, including results across block boundaries.
validation: Real-time Linux Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-hex-realtime-q9ny0kwp checked binary display and pagination, UTF-8 and hex boundary matches, repeated results, cancellation, mode switching and invalid byte input.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-hex-eur-vhuxoa4j checked a real extracted file’s hex display and byte search beyond 8 MiB using the browser File API.
limitations: Hex search accepts up to 1024 bytes; printable ASCII is a convenience display and does not interpret binary formats.
Synthetic attempt bpvljb2q failed because its expected ASCII row omitted remaining bytes; the assertion was corrected.
